messages:
Samir Patel: Heads-up — NexaHealth staging go-live hit a blocker during connector smoke tests, routing to this thread to coordinate triage.
Elaine Zhou: Saw the alert. What's the symptom?
EdgeWave (SI): We started the staged traffic shift at 11:02 PT — health checks on the edge connector intermittently fail with 502s to the private inference endpoint. No config changes on our side.
Marcus Lee: Can you paste the connector logs? Also which image SHA are you running?
EdgeWave (SI): Logs attached in the ticket, runtime image sha: rg.redwood/edge-connector:2026-03-17-abc123. Key log snippet: `ERROR upstream response: 502 gateway error, connection reset by peer`
Priya Nair: @Samir @Marcus tagging @oncall — we should treat this as P1 until staging is stable for go-live. Nexa is scheduled to cutover tomorrow.
Samir Patel: Agreed P1. Marcus can you check whether the private endpoint had any capacity or auth rejections around 11:00-11:10?
Marcus Lee: Querying metrics now — there was a spike in 502s from region-us-west-2 between 11:01–11:06 and a small uptick in TLS handshake timeouts. No quota or sfn throttles.
Marcus Lee: Also seeing intermittent 401s from the connector -> private control-plane for signature verification, looks correlated: `401 signature mismatch` in control-plane logs at 11:02:10, 11:02:14.
EdgeWave (SI): We rotated our deploy key yesterday per customer request. We updated the connector with the new key but kept the old key in case; should be fine. We didn't touch the signature scheme.
Elaine Zhou: That could explain 401s — did the customer update their KMS alias mapping? @Samir any changes from Nexa side?
Samir Patel: Nexa infra confirmed no KMS changes. They did push a firewall rule to tighten egress to the control-plane CIDR at 10:55 PT.
Priya Nair: Firewall change + key rotation seems like a likely root cause: certain control-plane endpoints returning signature errors when routed via new egress path (packet loss or MTU?).
Marcus Lee: Can we repro locally by routing over a simulated path? Meanwhile, quick mitigation: EdgeWave, can you roll the connector to use the old deploy key for a soft rollback?
EdgeWave (SI): We can re-deploy to old key in ~6 minutes. Doing canary to 5% first.
Samir Patel: Good. Also, Nexa — please temporarily open egress to control-plane CIDR 52.9.120.0/22 and 54.203.8.0/22 until we validate.
EdgeWave (SI): Canary shows health checks recovered at 5% traffic. No 401s in the canary window. Rolling to 50%.
deploy-bot: [deploy] Edge connector rollout to canary (old-key) started by EdgeWave (SI) — build rg.redwood/edge-connector:2026-03-17-abc123
Marcus Lee: After rolling to 50% traffic, 502s dropped to baseline. TLS handshake success rate up.
Elaine Zhou: If rollback fixes it, we should do postmortem: why did the new key + customer egress rule interact? Hypothesis: intermediate NAT device reassembles packets differently and the signature header got truncated (odd but seen before with MTU issues).
Samir Patel: Agreed. Action items: 1) EdgeWave finish full rollout to old key and confirm green (EdgeWave) 2) Marcus & Elaine validate control-plane logs and correlate MTU/packet drops (Marcus) 3) Nexa to keep egress relaxed for 2 hours and share fw rule diff (Nexa / Samir) 4) Postmortem draft after stabilization (Priya).
EdgeWave (SI): Full rollback complete, connector at 100% old-key. All health checks green. Rolling back didn't require image change.
Marcus Lee: Control-plane logs show the 401s stop once traffic hit the rollback. I also found several `fragmentation_needed` ICMP messages from an intermediate hop — suggests MTU/fragmentation.
Priya Nair: OK that's consistent. Marcus, can you capture a pcap or get tcpdump from the customer's bastion during a repro window? We'll need packet headers to confirm signature truncation.
Marcus Lee: Requesting pcap from Nexa infra now. If they can't, I'll spin a staging replica and force the same egress path.
Samir Patel: Nexa infra says they can provide tcpdump for a 15-min window starting 12:30 PT. Marcus please coordinate.
Elaine Zhou: For the postmortem, include a short mitigation playbook: how to detect signature truncation quickly, checklist for rollback to previous key, and recommended egress firewall guidance (allow control-plane CIDR + ICMP unreachable long enough for MTU discovery).
EdgeWave (SI): Noted. We'll also add an integration test in our deploy pipeline to validate signature round-trip when egress is narrowed.
Priya Nair: Great. I'll open a P1 incident ticket and schedule a 30-min postmortem sync at 13:15 PT once tcpdump is in. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: Thanks folks — keeping this channel for updates only. If anything changes rapidly, call the oncall number.
EdgeWave (SI): Copy. We'll update in-channel when we have tcpdump and when the postmortem is filed.
deploy-bot: [incident] P1 created: INC-2026-1321 by Priya Nair
Marcus Lee: Uploaded tcpdump to secure ticket link: https://redwood.app/tickets/INC-2026-1321/pcap (access: partners-only)
Priya Nair: Scheduling postmortem sync 13:15 PT. Invite sent to participants. Closing operational updates here, will append notes after the sync.
Samir Patel: Closing thread for live ops; feel free to re-open if regression observed.
